crossRefs.note: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
“Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him…
and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent…
through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
translations.bsb: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
translations.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
translations.asv: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.
